definitions.explanation: The practice of sampling and evaluating different types of sake, either professionally or as a leisure activity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{酒蔵|さかぐら}→酒蔵：08633_sakagura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{利|き}き{酒|ざけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I enjoyed sake tasting at the brewery.

examples.japanese: {利|き}き{酒|ざけ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered a sake tasting set.

examples.japanese: {利|き}き{酒|ざけ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦{銘柄|めいがら}→銘柄：14500_meigara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found my favorite brand through sake tasting.
